markers.title: Ukraine–Russia War
markers.detail: Europe’s largest high-intensity war since 1945. Active front lines, long-range strikes, and contested airspace.
markers.why: Sets European security posture, NATO aid levels, and energy/grain risk pricing.
markers.watch: Deep strikes, front advances/retreats, NATO air-defense stocks, civilian infrastructure hits.

markers.title: Iran / Hormuz Theater
markers.detail: Direct and proxy exchanges involving Iran, US, Israel, and Gulf states near a global oil artery.
markers.why: Hormuz handles a large share of seaborne oil; kinetic risk here moves energy markets fast.
markers.watch: Tanker incidents, claimed strikes, Strait transit disruptions, Gulf air-defense alerts.

markers.title: Taiwan Strait Pressure
markers.detail: Sustained PLA air and naval activity around Taiwan; median-line crossings and exercises are common signals.
markers.why: Critical Indo-Pacific deterrence node and semiconductor supply-chain risk.
markers.watch: Sortie counts, naval block-training, US/partner transit operations, political crisis triggers.

markers.title: Israel–Iran Axis Front
markers.detail: Multi-front residual risk across Israel, Lebanon, Iran, and regional proxies after years of cascading exchanges.
markers.why: Can re-open wider Middle East escalation that interacts with energy and nuclear dossiers.
markers.watch: Northern front fire, deep-strike claims, proxy mobilization, ceasefire durability.

markers.title: Sudan Civil War
markers.detail: Fighting between Sudanese Armed Forces and Rapid Support Forces with severe civilian impact.
markers.why: One of the world’s worst active humanitarian crises; regional spillover into the Horn/Sahel.
markers.watch: Control of cities, famine indicators, external backers, humanitarian access.

markers.title: Yemen / Red Sea
markers.detail: Houthi and related activity creates residual interdiction risk on Red Sea shipping lanes.
markers.why: Affects Bab el-Mandeb traffic, insurance rates, and Asia–Europe container routing.
markers.watch: Ship attacks, coalition responses, insurance war-risk premiums, Suez diversion rates.

markers.title: Myanmar Civil War
markers.detail: Multi-front fighting between the military junta and resistance forces across the country.
markers.why: Regional refugee flows, border instability, and limited ASEAN mediation leverage.
markers.watch: Territory shifts, border clashes with neighbors, aid access, elite defections.

markers.title: Strait of Hormuz
markers.detail: Primary oil chokepoint linking Persian Gulf producers to global markets.
markers.why: Even temporary disruption can spike crude prices and inflation expectations worldwide.
markers.watch: Transit volume claims, naval escorts, mine/drone reports, oil futures reaction.

markers.title: Bab el-Mandeb / Red Sea
markers.detail: Secondary energy and container chokepoint between the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden.
markers.why: Rerouting around Africa raises time/cost for Europe–Asia trade when risk rises.
markers.watch: Attack reports, carrier diversions, war-risk insurance, Suez Canal throughput.

markers.title: Persian Gulf Energy Complex
markers.detail: Cluster of major producers and export terminals (Saudi, UAE, Kuwait, Iraq, Iran exports).
markers.why: Production and export security here anchors global spare capacity narratives.
markers.watch: Facility security incidents, OPEC+ signals, export terminal disruptions.

markers.title: US Markets / New York
markers.detail: Major equity, rates, and risk-sentiment node. Public market moves often lag geopolitical shocks by hours to days.
markers.why: Shows how investors price conflict, energy, and policy risk in real time.
markers.watch: VIX/equity swings after kinetic headlines, energy equities, USD safe-haven moves.

markers.title: London / Europe Energy & Defense
markers.detail: European exposure to Middle East energy flows, Russian residual risk, and elevated defense spending.
markers.why: European gas, power prices, and defense budgets react strongly to Ukraine and Hormuz risk.
markers.watch: TTF gas prices, defense stock moves, UK/EU policy statements after escalation.

markers.title: Tokyo / Indo-Pacific Trade
markers.detail: Semiconductor and advanced manufacturing supply-chain node sensitive to Taiwan Strait risk.
markers.why: Japan is a core US ally and a critical chip/equipment supplier; Strait shocks hit Asian markets first.
markers.watch: Yen risk-off moves, chip equities, Japanese defense posture statements.

markers.title: moving around via radio
markers.detail: Social/OSINT report near Belgorod–Kharkiv axis. Treat as UNVERIFIED.
markers.why: Illustrative OSINT chatter near the front.
markers.watch: Corroboration by primary media or official statements.

stories.title: Iranian attack on Saudi tanker killed two Filipino sailors, Saudi Arabia says
stories.summary: The kingdom condemns the targeting of Sidr, which was reportedly hit by unknown projectiles in the Strait of Hormuz on Monday.

stories.title: Protests in Spain over government's handling of Ceuta migrant crisis
stories.summary: Spanish opposition parties accuse Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez of abandoning the residents of Ceuta.

stories.title: EU and Nato vow to step up pressure on Russia after 'new escalation' in Germany
stories.summary: Russia is accused of growing increasingly reckless after Berlin blamed Russia for a failed drone attack on Leipzig airport.

stories.title: Rosenberg: Putin's veiled threat to UK part of Russia's campaign against West
stories.summary: The Russian president wants to keep Britain guessing - and stressing - over Moscow's real intentions.

stories.title: Watch: Jury still unable to reach unanimous decision in Lindsay Clancy case
stories.summary: For a second time in two days, jurors told the judge they could not agree on a verdict in the murder trial.

stories.title: Maltese tycoon acquitted of orchestrating murder of renowned journalist
stories.summary: Daphne Caruana Galizia exposed corruption and money laundering schemes in Malta before she was killed by a car bomb in 2017.

stories.title: Netherlands moves billions in gold to London in 'crisis preparedness' move
stories.summary: The Dutch central bank removes some of its gold reserves from the US and Canada, saying it is because of "increasing geopolitical unrest".

stories.title: Iran says US strike killed four at wedding in 'war crime' as US denies targeting civilians
stories.summary: Iranian media reports two children were among those killed when shrapnel hit a home. Iran then launched missiles and drones at US targets in the Middle East.

stories.title: US sailors arrive in Thailand's Pattaya after record 250 days at sea
stories.summary: The USS Abraham Lincoln is docking close to Pattaya, known for its neon-lit nightlife, and for sex tourism.

stories.title: Uber shuts operations in Nigeria and Uganda with immediate effect
stories.summary: Nigeria - Africa's most populous country - is proving a tough market for ride-hailing services.

stories.title: Woman charged with juror intimidation in Lindsay Clancy trial
stories.summary: Dawn Light is accused of taking photos of jurors outside the Plymouth courthouse, a practice prohibited by the court.

stories.title: Zelensky says airlines should avoid Russian airspace as Ukraine escalates drone operations
stories.summary: Chinese and Gulf state airlines are among those still using Russian airspace. Meanwhile, Russia says it will intensify its own attacks on Ukraine.

stories.title: More than 900 killed in Gaza this year despite ceasefire, Hamas-run health ministry says
stories.summary: The ministry says the total number of people killed in the Strip since 10 October is now more than 1,300, including 301 children.

stories.title: South African airline behind daring stadium stunt cancels next flyby
stories.summary: The civil aviation authority says it is also investigating last Saturday's aerial display.

stories.title: Ariana Grande makes emotional tour exit and steps back from public life
stories.summary: The star makes an emotional farewell as she wraps up a tour she's described as her "last hurrah".

stories.title: What we know about reported strike on Iran wedding celebrations
stories.summary: BBC Verify looks at footage showing the aftermath of a strike on a building in southern Iran.

stories.title: BBC travels inside occupied Lebanon as officials say Israel expanding positions
stories.summary: A BBC team joined a humanitarian mission of the UN peacekeeping force, which says Israeli troops are fortifying positions and continuing demolitions.

stories.title: Bus crash on Egypt's Red Sea coast kills 22
stories.summary: Reports say Jordanian nationals are among those killed in the accident in the South Sinai governorate.

stories.title: Israel says Hamas security chief captured as strikes kill four during Gaza raid
stories.summary: The Israeli military says it carried out strikes in Gaza City during a raid by special forces to capture the head of Hamas's internal security service.

stories.title: Israel warns it will retaliate if UK imposes sanctions
stories.summary: The UK's Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband pledged on Tuesday to introduce a "comprehensive reset" of policy on Israel.

stories.title: US and Iran trade strikes for first time in weeks
stories.summary: The attack on Larak Island in the Strait of Hormuz - the first known US strike since late July - has killed two people and injured two others.

stories.title: 'I've never been to Afghanistan': Six million deportees forced to start over under the Taliban
stories.summary: As of August, the number forced to return this year from Pakistan and Iran had reached another million.

stories.title: Former British-Israeli Hamas hostage married in Tel Aviv
stories.summary: Damari, who was held for 15 months, married partner Dani Amit in a ceremony attended by other ex-hostages.

stories.title: Board of Peace's Gaza envoy criticises Israeli strikes and Hamas actions
stories.summary: Nickolay Mladenov warns that a collapse of last October's ceasefire would be "a point of no return" for the region.
